Article Title: FSSAI bans Everest, LG from selling hing
Article Text:
In the case of Everest, FSSAI has prohibited the sale of compounded (hing powder) variants with immediate effect.

NEW DELHI: The humble pinch of hing used in Indian kitchens has come under the scanner, with the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) issuing prohibition orders against Everest Food Products Private Limited and Laljee Godhoo and Company over non-compliance in compounded hing and asafoetida products. In a social media post, the food regulator said it had issued prohibition orders against the two companies under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. For Everest, samples of compounded asafoetida, yellow hing powder and black hing powder were found non-compliant with prescribed alcohol-soluble extract requirements. One sample recorded “zero per cent”, against required minimum of 5%, while yellow and black hing powder samples recorded 3.29% and 4.4%, respectively.The food regulator cited earlier compliance reviews that found violations in chicken masala, garam masala and egg curry powder, including label-declaration issues.
Article Summary: Food safety and standards authority of india issues prohibition orders against everest food products private limited and laljee godhoo and company. Regulator cites earlier compliance reviews that found violations in chicken masala, garam masala and egg curry powder, including label-declaration issues.

Article Title: Indian Standard Time to become mandatory for all entities from March 2027
Article Text:
Govt notifies Legal Metrology (IST) Rules, 2026, making IST mandatory for all legal, commercial and administrative activities from March 2027.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: From March next year, all entities in India will be required to use Indian Standard Time (IST) for legal, commercial, digital and administrative activities, with govt on Saturday notifying the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026.The rules, notified under the Legal Metrology Act, will come into force 180 days after their publication in Gazette, making IST mandatory from around March 2027. Violations of the rules will attract penalties under the Act.The notification makes IST the mandatory time reference for all legal, administrative and official documents unless specifically exempted. It also makes IST the standard time reference across commerce, transport, public administration, legal contracts and financial operations.Entities will not be allowed to use, display or record any time reference other than IST for official purposes, except where foreign time zones are clearly labelled or where alternative time sources are permitted for scientific research, navigation or astronomy.The rules are significant as modern digital infrastructure depends on microsecond-level timing accuracy. Payment systems, stock exchanges, telecom networks, 5G services, digital navigation, power grids and data centres require synchronised clocks to authenticate transactions, coordinate operations and maintain network reliability.The notification establishes a nationwide system for time synchronisation, traceability and cybersecurity, recognising accurate time as critical digital infrastructure. Under the rules, CSIR-National Physical Laboratory (NPL) will continue to maintain India’s primary time scale, UTC(NPLI), from which IST is derived, while Regional Reference Standards Laboratories (RRSLs), ISRO’s NavIC and other authorised timing sources will disseminate official time.Another major feature of the rules is the focus on cyber resilience. Organisations must deploy proper time-synchronisation systems, protect networks against spoofing, jamming and cyberattacks, integrate multiple authorised timing sources and maintain contingency mechanisms, including atomic clocks where necessary, to ensure uninterrupted operations.
Article Summary: Govt notifies legal metrology (ist) rules, 2026, making ist mandatory for all legal, commercial and administrative activities from march 2027. Violations of the rules will attract penalties under the act. The rules are significant as modern digital infrastructure depends on microsecond-level timing accuracy.

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a petition on August 31 seeking a directive to the Centre and others to ensure mandatory and uniform labelling on every dispensing nozzle at petrol pumps, disclosing the exact percentage of ethanol in petrol.According to the apex court's causelist of August 31, the plea would come up for hearing before a bench comprising Justices M M Sundresh and Prasanna B Varale.The petition, filed by Narendra Kumar Goswami, has also sought a direction that every fuel invoice should specifically and legibly state the percentage of ethanol in the petrol sold."Direct the respondents (Centre and others) to prepare and publish within a stipulated time an official, public, vehicle-wise compatibility database searchable by manufacturer, model, engine type and year of manufacture, indicating the suitability or otherwise of various ethanol blends for each vehicle," the plea said.It has also sought constitution of an independent expert committee comprising representatives from the ministries of petroleum and natural gas, road transport and highways, the Bureau of Indian Standards and others, including independent automobile engineers, to examine and submit a public report on real-world vehicle compatibility of E20 across the existing fleet.The plea said the committee should also submit a report on the impact on fuel efficiency, engine longevity and maintenance costs, warranty and insurance implications, the net environmental footprint, including tail-pipe emissions and water consumption associated with ethanol production, and food-security and feed-diversion concerns allegedly arising from the blending programme."Direct the respondents to frame a national consumer disclosure protocol for all ethanol-blended petrol, in consultation with the Central Consumer Protection Authority and the Bureau of Indian Standards," it said.It also sought directions to the concerned authorities to place before the apex court all policy files, technical studies, compatibility reports, safety standards, consumer advisories and records of public consultation that support the compulsory roll-out of E20.The plea called on authorities to formulate and publish within a time-bound period a transparent transition framework for legacy and non-compatible vehicles, including consideration of designated availability of lower ethanol petrol wherever technically, economically and logistically feasible, together with a reasoned decision supported by expert material and public consultation.
Article Summary: The supreme court is scheduled to hear a petition on august 31. The petition seeks a directive to the centre and others to ensure mandatory labelling on every dispensing nozzle at petrol pumps, disclosing the exact percentage of ethanol in petrol. It has also sought constitution of an independent expert committee.

Article Title: Government tightens norms for e-cycles, e-bikes
Article Text:
Road transport ministry plans to tighten norms for e-cycles & e-bikes with max speed of 25kmph and motor power below 600 watt.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The road transport ministry has proposed to tighten technical and safety norms for low-speed electric cycles and e-bikes with a maximum speed of 25 kmph and motor power below 600 watts. Manufacturers of these would have to get vehicles certified by authorised testing agencies before they can qualify for exemption from the Motor Vehicles Act to be treated as “motor vehicle”.At present, electric two-wheelers that have motor power below 250 watts are not treated as “motor vehicles” and hence don’t need registration. This definition is now being expanded to vehicles that have motor power up to 600 watts, which officials said is “realistic”.All these vehicles will be required to use only lithium-ion batteries instead of lead-acid batteries.As per draft amendments to Central Motor Vehicles Rules, such vehicles will have to be fitted with “suitable brakes and retro-reflective devices” for visibility. The draft notification said for pedal-assisted electric bicycles, the motor assistance must progressively reduce and cut off once the vehicle reaches 25 kmph or when the rider stops pedalling.The proposal is significant considering that low-speed electric two-wheelers have witnessed rapid growth as affordable urban mobility options, but many models have operated with limited regulatory oversight.
Article Summary: Road transport ministry plans to tighten norms for e-cycles & e-bikes with max speed of 25kmph and motor power below 600 watt. Manufacturers of these would have to get vehicles certified by authorised testing agencies before they can qualify for exemption from the motor vehicles act.

Article Title: Year-wise plan to implement Samudra Manthan in works
Article Text:
Petroleum minister Hardeep Puri reviewed the action taken on decisions from two brainstorming sessions on the rollout of the scheme, which received Cabinet’s approval, said officials. (Photo: IANS)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Government is likely to finalise a year-wise plan soon for drilling, seismic surveys and rig deployment under Samudra Manthan, a Rs 84,084-crore national programme aimed at stepping up oil and gas exploration in India’s offshore basins and reducing dependence on energy imports.Officials said petroleum minister Hardeep Puri recently reviewed the action taken on decisions from two brainstorming sessions held in Gurgaon in Haryana and Duliajan in Assam, on the rollout of the scheme, which received Cabinet’s approval last month.The year-wise roadmap will help government carry out exploration and production activities in a concerted manner across Krishna-Godavari (KG), Mahanadi, Andaman and Cauvery basins and ensure systematic utilisation of funds, an official said.The scheme will fund acquisition, processing and interpretation of seismic data, scientific drilling in frontier basins, accelerated exploration in deepwater and ultra-deepwater blocks, and development of shared offshore production and evacuation infrastructure.While Rs 43,200 crore has been earmarked for drilling 60 exploratory deepwater wells over five years, Rs 28,534 crore has been allocated for acquisition of 2D and 3D seismic data, Rs 10,000 crore for common infrastructure hubs and Rs 2,000 crore for an oil and gas manufacturing and services zone.India’s annual crude oil requirement is around 256 million tonnes (MT), of which nearly 88 per cent is imported. Domestic crude oil production from 26 sedimentary basins is estimated at around 28 MT. With domestic output stagnating even as demand continues to rise, government has been looking to step up exploration to improve energy security and reduce import dependence.Samudra Manthan is expected to add more than 600 million metric tonnes of oil equivalent (MMTOE) to the country’s hydrocarbon reserves and boost domestic production of crude oil and natural gas.Officials said government has implemented a series of upstream sector reforms over the past decade, including opening up almost the entire offshore acreage for exploration, changes to legal and contractual framework, and strengthening National Data Repository. Samudra Manthan would complement these reforms by providing public funding for offshore exploration and facilitating the deployment of advanced technologies, they said.The scheme also includes dedicated provisions for digital programme management, capacity building, technology adoption, stakeholder engagement and international outreach, creating an integrated ecosystem to accelerate offshore exploration and production in the country.
Article Summary: Samudra manthan is a rs 84,084-crore national programme aimed at stepping up oil and gas exploration in india’s offshore basins. The scheme will fund acquisition, processing and interpretation of seismic data, scientific drilling in frontier basins, accelerated exploration in deepwater and ultra-deepwater blocks.

Article Title: Wireless communication picked up; search operation launched in J&K's Samba
Article Text:
The hilly area of Sumb is considered strategically important from a security perspective. (PTI photo)

JAMMU: Security forces launched a joint search operation in the remote, hilly hamlet of Sumb in J&K’s Samba district after receiving information that a wireless set had been briefly activated in the area and satellite communication was detected around 1pm Tuesday.“The reported activation of Iridium satellite sets raised suspicion among security agencies, following which a combined team of the Army, police, and personnel from other forces rushed to Sumb’s Makoli village and initiated extensive searches in and around the area,” an official said Wednesday.“Terrorists often switch off such communication devices after contacting their handlers across the border,” said a source, adding that Iridium sets can be used on smartphones through the “Iridium GO!” mobile application, which creates a local Wi-Fi network that an iOS or Android phone can connect to.The operation continued until late Tuesday, but no satellite set or other suspicious material was found. Security was tightened along all routes leading to Sumb, with J&K Police and Village Defence Guards maintaining strict vigil, officials said.The hilly area of Sumb is considered strategically important from a security perspective as the route runs along the Basantar river and leads towards the India-Pakistan international border. Due to its proximity to the border, Samba district is a hotbed of terrorist activities. It serves as a gateway district for ultras heading towards Kashmir Valley via the upper reaches of Samba-Udhampur-Doda-Kishtwar.
Article Summary: Security forces launched a joint search operation in the remote, hilly hamlet of sumb in j&k’s samba district after receiving information that a wireless set had been briefly activated. Article Title: Daejon Love case explained: How a fake 49ers player allegedly fooled 26 women and pulled off a $1,300,000 scam
Article Text:
Image - X

Daejon Love : the man who faked being a 49ers player, bought a $1,160 helmet, and scammed 26 women out of $1.3 million

"That's Google, that's not me."

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The internet's reaction has been brutal

Picture this: a match on a dating app with a guy who says he plays wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers. He shows up to the first date in a jersey, a helmet in the back seat of his car, like he just walked off practice. He talks about a future together, about investments that'll make you both rich. You believe him, and why wouldn't you? He even showed you the Google search proving it. Then one day the calls stop, the messages stop, and you're left wondering where your money went.That's the story 26 women say they lived through with Daejon Labrayae Love, 35, except he never played a single down for the 49ers. On August 24, the FBI arrested Love and his 18-year-old accomplice Taylor Jamie Chan at Boise Airport, where he'd reportedly gone to meet new victims.Federal prosecutors say the pair ran a romance-and-investment scam across California, Oregon, Washington, and Idaho for over four years, taking $1.3 million, and the FBI believes many more victims haven't come forward yet.Here's everything that's surfaced since, including the one detail that's making the internet lose it.Love met most victims on dating apps like Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, and Facebook Dating and then built entire fake lives around them.He posed as a 49ers player under aliases including Jon Love, Jordan Love, and Avril Lyto Love, and separately claimed to be a wealthy real estate investor. Chan played the "financial adviser," backing up his fake investment pitches so victims believed their money was actually growing somewhere.Court documents describe just how far Love went to sell it. He allegedly spent over $1,160 on a custom replica helmet from a football gear vendor, filmed himself "signing" a fake 49ers contract while dripping in jewelry, and even showed up to a first date in a jersey with a helmet sitting in his car.When victims got suspicious, prosecutors say he'd send them screenshots of Google's AI Overview falsely listing him as an NFL player, and if they pushed back, his line was reportedly,Once someone ran out of money or asked too many questions, he cut them off and kept whatever they'd sent.Once the case went public, former NFL linebacker Su'a Cravens couldn't hold back, joking that victims should've just tried to FaceTime him on game day. Sports accounts piled on with a running joke that the 49ers' offseason had somehow gotten messier than the season itself between a Brandon Aiyuk contract standoff, owner Jed York's arrest, Kyle Shanahan's car accident, and now a guy who invented an entire fake roster spot.Both Love and Chan are in federal custody in Boise facing wire fraud and conspiracy charges, with an initial court appearance already held. Nothing has been proven in court yet, and both are presumed innocent, but if even a fraction of what prosecutors allege is true, this might be the most elaborate catfish the NFL world has ever indirectly been dragged into.Would a real player really need a Google search to prove it? That's the part nobody on the internet is letting go of.
Article Summary: Daejon labrayae love, 35, was arrested on august 24 at boise airport. He allegedly scammed 26 women out of $1.3 million in a romance-and-investment scam. He posed as a 49ers player under aliases including jon love, jordan love, and avril lyto love.

How to apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

The Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, has released the India Post Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July 2026 notification. Issued under Advertisement Number 17-12/2026-GDS on August 27, 2026, the recruitment drive will fill more than 25,000 vacancies for Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM) and Dak Sevak posts across postal circles.The one-time registration process will begin on August 31, 2026, while the online application and fee payment window will open on September 2 at 5 pm. Candidates can submit applications until September 21, 2026, at 5 pm. Applicants should check the circle-wise vacancies, eligibility conditions and regional language requirements before selecting their preferences.The recruitment covers more than 25,000 GDS posts. The positions include BPM, ABPM and Dak Sevak roles. Applicants must have passed Class 10 with Mathematics and English and possess knowledge of the relevant local language. Basic computer knowledge and cycling skills are also required.The age limit is 18 to 40 years, calculated as on September 21, 2026. Age relaxation will apply according to the prescribed rules.Male candidates belonging to the UR, OBC and EWS categories must pay a Rs. 100 application fee. SC, ST, PwBD, female and transwomen candidates are exempted from the fee.BPMs will receive Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA) of Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380, while ABPMs and Dak Sevaks will receive Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470. The working requirement is a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours daily.Selected BPMs must arrange accommodation for the Branch Post Office at their own cost and reside within the post village. ABPMs and Dak Sevaks must reside within the delivery jurisdiction of the concerned Post Office.Selection will be based on a system-generated merit list prepared using Class 10 marks calculated to four decimal places. Shortlisted candidates will undergo physical document verification, followed by medical examination and pre-engagement formalities.Candidates should visit the official India Post GDS online engagement portal, complete OTR using their mobile number and email ID, enter Class 10 details, select postal divisions and post preferences, upload the required photograph and signature, pay the applicable fee and submit the application before the deadline.

Article Title: Who is Gautam Rangarajan? Indian-origin strategist appointed to key role by UK PM Andy Burnham
Article Text:
Indian-origin strategist Gautam Rangarajan.

Who is Gautam Rangarajan ?

What will Gautam Rangarajan do at No. 10?

Burnham's government overhaul

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has appointed Indian-origin strategist and former BBC executive Gautam Rangarajan as an Expert Adviser on Structure and Process in a newly created role at 10 Downing Street.Rangarajan, who brings decades of experience in strategy, organisational transformation and media, is set to take up the position this week.Rangarajan is a senior strategist and media executive with more than two decades of experience across media, creative industries and public service broadcasting.Before his new government role, he spent more than 30 years at the BBC, beginning his career as a radio music producer and eventually rising to become the broadcaster's Group Director for Strategy and Performance.His experience includes developing strategy in rapidly changing markets, leading large-scale transformation initiatives and handling complex policy and financial negotiations.The exact details of Rangarajan's responsibilities are yet to be outlined. However, the UK PM's office said his appointment draws on his experience in corporate strategy and transformation.His role comes as Burnham undertakes a broader restructuring of the machinery of government, including the creation of the Office for the Prime Minister and Cabinet.Rangarajan is expected to play a role in the planned transformation at the heart of the British government.Away from strategy and public service, Rangarajan also has a creative side. He describes himself as a professional choral singer and music producer, alongside his work in corporate strategy and organisational transformation.The appointment comes as Burnham reshapes his government following his recent rise to the role of Labour Party leader and Prime Minister.His administration has announced structural changes, including the launch of No. 10 North in Manchester and the creation of the Office for the Prime Minister and Cabinet.While the full scope of Rangarajan's new role remains unclear, his appointment places the former BBC executive at the centre of the UK government's planned transformation.

Article Title: Quote of the day by Michael J. Fox: "I think the scariest person in the world is the person with…" - a lesson on humour, perspective and facing hard times with lightness
Article Text:
Quote of the day by Michael J. Fox (AP photo)

Quote of the day by Michael J. Fox

"I think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor"

Where this quote actually comes from

Why humour matters most during genuinely difficult stretches

How humour actually helps people manage stress

Why laughing at your own mistakes actually matters

Why humour can genuinely strengthen relationships

Michael J. Fox's own perspective on adversity

Why humour is not the same thing as avoiding a real problem

Why being naturally serious is not actually a flaw

Other memorable quotes by Michael J. Fox

"One's dignity may be assaulted, vandalized and cruelly mocked, but it can never be taken away unless it is surrendered."

"I am careful not to confuse excellence with perfection."

"Family is not an important thing. It's everything."

"Acceptance doesn't mean resignation; it means understanding that something is what it is and that there's got to be a way through it."

Why people still find meaning in this quote

Humour can genuinely change how a difficult moment actually feels. A stressful situation seems lighter once someone finds a reason to laugh, and a serious problem often becomes easier to approach once it can be seen from another angle. It can create a little distance from fear, frustration and uncertainty, even when the circumstances themselves have not changed. Michael J. Fox , the actor and Parkinson's disease advocate, put a striking twist on that idea. "I think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor," he said. Not being able to laugh, in his framing, is not simply a personality quirk. It genuinely limits how someone can respond to life, and coming from someone who has lived with a serious, lifelong illness for decades, the line carries a good deal more weight than a passing joke.This line comes from an interview Fox gave to journalist Amy Wallace, published on Reader's Digest's website. Fox is not really suggesting that a humourless person is dangerous in any literal sense. He is pointing at the seriousness that tends to surround someone who cannot laugh at themselves, cannot recognise irony, and cannot find any lightness in a genuinely difficult moment. Humour creates real distance from a problem.It lets someone acknowledge that something is hard without letting it completely take over.Life inevitably brings disappointment, uncertainty and real stress. Humour cannot solve every problem on its own, but it can genuinely change how someone responds to one. Being able to laugh during a hard period offers a small emotional break, and it can help people communicate when a direct, serious conversation feels too uncomfortable to actually have. None of this means every situation deserves to be treated as a joke. Humour and genuine seriousness can exist side by side.Stress tends to narrow someone's attention down entirely onto the immediate problem in front of them. A moment of real laughter can interrupt that cycle. Research into humour and stress has suggested that positive humour can genuinely influence mood and help people cope with stressful experiences, and laughter itself is linked to physiological changes, including a release of muscle tension. None of this should be overstated. Humour is never a substitute for professional help or a practical solution when someone faces a genuinely serious problem. As an everyday coping tool, though, it can offer a genuinely useful shift in perspective.One of the most valuable forms of humour is simply being able to laugh at your own missteps. Nobody gets everything right. People mispronounce words, misjudge situations and occasionally embarrass themselves, and someone who can acknowledge a mistake without being consumed by embarrassment tends to find it easier to actually learn from it. Self-directed humour also tends to make social interactions considerably more comfortable, since it signals that a person does not expect flawless perfection from either themselves or anyone else around them.Shared laughter helps people form real connections. Friends, colleagues and family members often use humour to build a sense of familiarity and trust, and a well-placed joke can break tension that a serious conversation might struggle to shift on its own. There is an important line here worth being clear about, between humour that actually brings people together and humour that humiliates someone else. Jokes built on cruelty or prejudice tend to damage relationships rather than genuinely strengthen them, and the most constructive kind of humour has never really needed anyone else to get hurt.Fox became one of the most recognisable actors of his generation through films and television, including Back to the Future and Family Ties. In 1991, at the age of 29, he was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. He later made the diagnosis public and became a prominent advocate for Parkinson's research through the Michael J. Fox Foundation. His public approach to living with the condition has consistently included honesty, genuine optimism and humour, which gives his comments about laughter an extra dimension. His point was never that difficult experiences are inherently funny. It is that holding onto a sense of humour can help someone preserve real perspective while actually facing a genuine challenge. His decades-long relationship with humour, cultivated alongside a chronic illness he never chose, reveals that laughter was never a denial of hardship for Fox, but a deliberate, hard-won tool for maintaining perspective and genuine hope through real adversity.There is a meaningful difference between using humour to cope with something difficult and using it to avoid actually dealing with it at all. Some problems genuinely require serious attention and real action, and nobody can simply laugh away financial difficulty, illness or grief. What humour can offer instead is a small amount of emotional breathing space while someone continues addressing the actual underlying issue, which is really the whole distinction worth holding onto here.Fox's quote is deliberately provocative, and it should not be read as suggesting that serious people are inherently unpleasant. Some people naturally have quieter personalities, or simply express humour in a different way. The broader lesson is really about flexibility rather than personality type. Someone who can be genuinely serious when it matters, while still finding moments of humour elsewhere, tends to have more ways of responding to life's challenges than someone who treats every single situation with exactly the same level of weight.Humour is easy to underrate, since it can look insignificant next to more obviously serious qualities like intelligence or discipline. Even so, the ability to laugh genuinely shapes how people communicate, handle their own mistakes and respond to real difficulty. Fox's quote offers a deliberately provocative reminder that life does not always need to be approached with complete seriousness. There will be moments when humour is genuinely inappropriate, and problems that cannot be laughed away at all. In between those moments, though, holding onto a sense of humour tends to keep people connected, flexible and hopeful, which is really the whole point behind the line.
Article Summary: "i think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor" michael j. Fox, actor and parkinson's disease advocate. Not being able to laugh is not simply a personality quirk. It genuinely limits how someone can respond to life. Michael j. Fox was one of the most recognisable actors of his generation.

Article Title: These are the 10 top-selling smartphones across the world right now
Article Text:
Full list of World's Top 10 best-selling smartphones (Q2 2026)

Why Apple's iPhone 17 series is dominating

How Samsung Galaxy S26 series performed

Why the Galaxy A series continues to sell well

Apple’s iPhone 17 has topped the list of the world’s best-selling smartphones for the April-June quarter of 2026, grabbing 6% of all global smartphone unit sales, according to fresh data from Counterpoint Research's Global Handset Model Sales Tracker. Right behind it on the list are two more Apple devices, the iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPhone 17 Pro, rounding out the top three spots. Samsung, however, wasn’t far behind either. The company managed to place two of its Galaxy S series phones in the overall top 10, with the Galaxy S26 Ultra standing out as Samsung’s top-performing model for the quarter – climbing an impressive five ranks compared to where its predecessor stood a year earlier.Together, Apple and Samsung claimed five spots each within the top 10 list, jointly making up 26% of all smartphones sold worldwide during the quarter, registering a rise of 2% compared to the same period last year. Interestingly, this combined share for the top 10 phones turned out to be the highest ever recorded for a June-ending quarter, even as the broader smartphone market shrank by 11% overall.Much of this concentration is being attributed to smartphone brands narrowing their focus toward flagship and high-volume models, largely as a way to work around the ongoing global shortage of RAM chips.iPhone 17 5GiPhone 17 Pro Max 5GiPhone 17 Pro 5GGalaxy S26 Ultra 5GGalaxy A07 4GGalaxy A17 5GiPhone 17E 5GGalaxy A17 4GGalaxy S26 5GiPhone 16 5GSpeaking on Apple’s strong showing, Counterpoint's senior analyst Karn Chauhan noted that Apple’s overall unit sales grew 5% year-on-year, even as the wider smartphone market contracted.“iPhone sales increased across India, Japan, and the MEA, and nearly doubled in South Korea in Q2 2026, driven by the iPhone 17 series. The base iPhone 17 model remained the best-selling smartphone during the quarter, supported by significant upgrades that narrowed the gap with the Pro models,” he said.“Meanwhile, strong premium demand drove the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max sales, aided by trade-in programs, promotions, and accessible financing options that improved affordability. Rising smartphone prices also pushed consumers towards the higher-end segments, further strengthening Apple's competitive position,” Chauhan added.The iPhone 17e also played a role in keeping Apple's presence strong on the list, thanks to the addition of MagSafe support and increased internal storage, all while holding on to the same price point as the previous year's model.Turning to Samsung’s lineup, senior analyst Harshit Rastogi highlighted that the Galaxy S26 Ultra emerged as the best-selling Android smartphone globally for the quarter, marking the first time an ultra-premium Android device has led Android sales specifically during a June-ending quarter.“Meanwhile, the later launch of the Galaxy S26 series compared with the Galaxy S25 series shifted more sales into Q2, the Galaxy S26 Ultra outperformed its predecessor and accounted for more than half of the series' sales. Industry-first privacy display along with enhanced AI capabilities differentiate the smartphone from its peers. Samsung has further increased its focus on flagship smartphones, boosting promotions and strategically allocating resources to mitigate the revenue decline amid rising costs,” Rastogi pointed out.Samsung’s budget and mid-range Galaxy A series phones also held their ground on the list, due to their affordability, broad availability and strong overall value for money. It's worth noting that every single Galaxy A series device that made it into the top 10 comes with at least six years of software support – a factor that aligns well with the growing trend of people holding on to their phones for longer before upgrading.
Article Summary: Apple's iphone 17 has topped the list of the world’s best-selling smartphones for the april-june quarter of 2026, grabbing 6% of all global smartphone unit sales. Right behind it on the list are two more apple devices, the iphone 17 pro max and iphone 17pro, rounding out the top three spots.

Article Title: After CEO Marc Benioff told everyone to stop getting worried, Salesforce does what it has never done before with its 'name'
Article Text:
When Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said that stop worrying about SaaSpocalypse

Just months after the Salesforce CEO told everyone to stop getting anxious about AI taking away software jobs, the company has joined hands with one of the biggest AI companies to do what it has never done before. Salesforce and Anthropic expanded their strategic partnership and unveiled 'Claudeforce', a new way for salespeople to work within Anthropic’s product. The announcement marks the first time that Salesforce has ever added its "Force" suffix at the end of another company's product.Claudeforce is launching as a plugin with 37 pre-built sales skills that will allow Claude users to compose emails, update records and take other relevant actions, according to a release. The companies said they plan to introduce more integrations across Claude, Salesforce and its messaging platform Slack in the future.“By fusing Claude’s extraordinary reasoning with the trusted data, workflows, and governance every enterprise runs on, we’re delivering a dynamic interface that thinks, reasons, and acts,” Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said in a statement. “This is how every business will run.”In February this year, Salesforce pulled out all the stops to convince investors that the AI revolution won’t be its death when it announced fourth-quarter earnings. The huge clarification came as the Software-as-a-service (SaaS) stocks, with Salesforce as their poster child, continued to get hammered lately. Fearing that the rise of AI agents will undermine software companies, making their per-employee-seat business models obsolete, investors have been running away from them. The situation has been dubbed the “SaaSpocalypse.” The concept reportedly hung so heavily in the air during the earnings call that CEO Marc Benioff mentioned the term at least six times.“You’ve heard about the SaaSpocalypse? And it isn’t our first. We’ve had a few of them,” he said, later adding, “If there is a SaaSpocalypse, it may be eaten by the Sasquatch because there are a lot of companies using a lot of SaaS because it just got better with agents.”“Through this partnership, companies can point Claude at the customer information and business context that they’ve been building in Salesforce for decades — surfacing the insights that really matter and helping their businesses run more efficiently and grow more quickly,” Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said in a statement.All in all, Salesforce and its software peers have been under pressure as investors question whether AI tools from companies like Anthropic and OpenAI will replace them. Salesforce shares are down about 22% this year after dropping 20% in 2025. The Nasdaq, meanwhile, is up about 35% since the end of 2024.
Article Summary: Claudeforce is a plugin with 37 pre-built sales skills that will allow claude users to compose emails, update records and take other relevant actions. The announcement marks the first time that salesforce has ever added its "force" suffix at the end of another company's product.

Article Title: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu's advice to engineers entering business: Learn to sell, face rejection
Article Text:
As per Sridhar Vembu, selling can also improve communication skills.

Sridhar Vembu says business begins with selling

The simple lesson behind Sridhar Vembu's advice

Moving from engineering, medicine or science into business can require learning a skill that many professionals may not encounter in their regular work: selling. In an X (formerly Twitter) post, Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu shared a simple piece of advice for engineers, scientists and doctors who want to enter the business world—go on sales calls and learn to deal with rejection. Vembu said that technical knowledge alone is not enough to build a business. He argued that speaking directly with potential customers can help professionals explain their ideas better, understand the value of sales and develop the skills needed to run a business.“If you are an engineer or scientist or doctor turning to business, the first thing I would suggest is ‘Please go on a lot of sales calls, face rejection if necessary, but persist’,” Sridhar Vembu wrote in the post.According to Vembu, selling can also improve communication skills. People with technical backgrounds may understand their products or ideas deeply, but explaining them to someone else—and convincing that person to pay for them—is a different challenge.“You will develop better communication skills as you realise that explaining your ideas is not so easy,” he said.Sales calls can also change the way professionals view salespeople.Vembu said people who spend time trying to sell a product may develop greater respect for those whose job involves speaking to customers and handling rejection every day.“You will develop respect for sales people. You may even become good at business!” he added.At the heart of Vembu's post is a basic idea: a business cannot survive without customers and sales.“There is no such thing as a business without selling something. Sometimes the most obvious thing has to be said!” Vembu wrote.
Article Summary: Zoho founder sridhar vembu says business begins with selling. Selling can help professionals explain their ideas better, understand the value of sales and develop the skills needed to run a business. Sales calls can also change the way professionals view salespeople.

Article Title: Satya Nadella recently shared a rare data point, said that annual revenue of Microsoft's Cloud computing division topped $100 billion; but why it left some analysts 'unhappy'
Article Text:
Satya Nadella

What Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella revealed about company’s cloud business

‘Capital spending numbers don't add up cleanly’

Why Azure's hidden numbers matter so much

Microsoft’s cloud business recently crossed a major milestone, but the company still isn’t telling investors the full story, a report has said. CEO Satya Nadella revealed on an earnings call that Azure’s annual revenue has topped $100 billion for the first time – which is a rare disclosure from a company that has long kept its cloud numbers under wraps. Yet even this headline figure hasn’t been enough to satisfy analysts, who reportedly say Microsoft's financial reporting remains far less transparent than its biggest rivals. Across three key pillars shaping the company’s AI future, its cloud business, its capital spending and its ties with OpenAI, Microsoft's disclosures fall noticeably short of what shareholders would ideally want to see, as per a report by The Wall Street Journal.In its most recent annual report, Microsoft simply stated that “Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 41%” for the fiscal year ending June 30. Notably absent were the actual dollar figures, comparison numbers from the previous year, and any breakdown of expenses or profits tied specifically to Azure. During Microsoft’s July earnings call, Nadella did offer one unusual nugget, revealing that Azure's annual revenue had crossed the $100 billion mark.Instead of breaking Azure out on its own, Microsoft folds it into a broader category called “Intelligent Cloud,” which also includes older legacy software products. This leaves investors guessing where the legacy revenue stops and Azure’s actual growth begins. Compare this to Amazon, which reports Amazon Web Services, the largest cloud provider globally, as its own separate segment complete with sales figures, expenses, and margins. Azure ranks second in the cloud market, yet its financial details remain largely hidden from public view.Microsoft’s cash-flow statement showed $115.9 billion spent on property and equipment last year, a figure the company itself used to calculate free cash flow. However, in a separate release, the company reported total capital expenditure of $145.3 billion, a number that included assets acquired through finance leases. While Microsoft does share separate figures for finance leases, simply adding them to the property and equipment spending doesn't actually match the $145.3 billion total, and the company hasn't offered any explanation reconciling the difference.This lack of segment-level clarity carries the biggest consequences for investors trying to understand where Microsoft's money is actually going. Most of the company’s massive capital spending is being funnelled into Azure, the platform running on an enormous web of data centers that powers much of today’s internet and fuels many AI models.By burying Azure inside the broader Intelligent Cloud segment, Microsoft effectively conceals the true margins, costs and capital intensity behind its AI expansion. This blending mixes an expensive AI infrastructure business with a separate, high-margin software business, making it impossible to see how profitable Azure actually is on its own.Intelligent Cloud is one of Microsoft's three operating segments and accounted for 42% of total sales last year. Its revenue climbed 30% to roughly $138 billion, while the cost of that revenue rose even faster at 44%, reaching $58 billion. Operating expenses grew 7% to $23 billion, leaving operating income at about $57 billion, up 28% from the year before.Somewhere buried within these combined figures sits Azure's actual performance, numbers Microsoft has chosen not to disclose separately. Yet oddly, the company provides far more detailed breakdowns for much smaller businesses, like Xbox and LinkedIn, which brought in about $22 billion and $20 billion respectively last year.
Article Summary: Microsoft ceo satya nadella revealed on an earnings call that azure’s annual revenue has topped $100 billion for the first time. Yet even this headline figure hasn’t been enough to satisfy analysts, who reportedly say microsoft's financial reporting remains far less transparent than its biggest rivals.

Article Title: Google Cloud launches Gemini Enterprise to automate law firm workflows with AI agents
Article Text:
Addressing legal-specific needs

The four core components

The workflows Google is targeting

Google Cloud has introduced Gemini Enterprise for Legal, a new AI product purpose-built for law firms and corporate legal departments, aiming to automate complex legal workflows from contract review to regulatory compliance. The announcement, made Monday from Delhi and Sunnyvale, positions the offering as part of a broader push by Google into industry-specific AI tools, with Gemini Enterprise for Legal launching alongside a parallel version for financial services.Google is framing the product as a direct response to the limitations general-purpose AI tools run into when applied to legal work — namely, an inability to reliably meet requirements like strict confidentiality, ethical walls between clients, verified legal authority, and complete data isolation. According to the company, trying to solve those problems by stringing together disconnected point solutions typically results in fragile, expensive-to-maintain workflows.Gemini Enterprise for Legal instead connects directly into a firm's existing document and matter management systems, automatically inheriting a firm's ethical walls in the process. Legal research generated through the platform is grounded in primary legal authority rather than relying solely on the underlying model's training data, and client data, playbooks, and negotiated positions are designed to remain permanently within a firm's private data perimeter.Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said agentic AI gives legal professionals the ability to research case law, build arguments, and automate routine tasks in ways that create real value for clients, while stressing that accuracy and grounding in legal authority remain essential to that work.Google describes the platform as resting on four main pillars. The first is a set of purpose-built skills that guide AI agents through specific legal tasks, including legal brief drafting, citation verification, contract lifecycle management, regulatory horizon scanning, and fulfilling data subject access requests (DSARs).The second is a set of secure connectors, built using the Model Context Protocol, linking the platform to major legal industry systems including Docusign, Everlaw, iManage, NetDocuments, RelativityOne, Thomson Reuters, Harvey, Legora, and the Free Law Project's CourtListener database, among others.The third is a broader partner ecosystem of third-party legal tech providers and consulting firms building on top of the platform, including Accenture, Deloitte, and KPMG. The fourth is the underlying Gemini Enterprise platform itself, which gives IT and risk teams a centralized control plane with built-in audit logging, risk management, and governance.Google outlined several specific legal workflows it says the platform is designed to accelerate. On the compliance side, the system can proactively track legislative changes, court dockets, and regulatory activity, cross-referencing new developments against a firm's internal policies to flag potential exposure and draft updated policy language for attorney review. It's also designed to automate data discovery for privacy requests, compiling personal data scattered across enterprise systems to help meet DSAR deadlines with less manual effort.For transactional work, the platform benchmarks incoming vendor agreements, NDAs, and M&A documents against a firm's own playbooks, surfacing high-risk clauses so attorneys can focus their time on negotiation and judgment calls rather than first-pass review. It can also convert a firm's historical contract archive into a living, structured playbook by extracting key terms and fallback positions automatically. Additional targeted use cases include preparing and redacting court filings for motions to seal, and drafting NDAs with built-in structural and formatting consistency.
Article Summary: Gemini enterprise for legal is a new ai product purpose-built for law firms and corporate legal departments. It aims to automate complex legal workflows from contract review to regulatory compliance. Google is framing the product as a direct response to limitations general-purpose ai tools run into when applied to legal work.

Article Title: Spotify launches Premium Early Access in India, Badshah and Harrdy Sandhu among first releases
Article Text: Music streaming app Spotify has launched Premium Early Access in India, allowing Premium subscribers to listen to select new music releases up to three days before they become available to everyone else. The feature will be available from August 28. As announced by the company, Universal Music Group (UMG) will be the first label to launch its ‘Hear It First’ campaign under the new framework. After the early access window ends, the releases will be available to all Spotify listeners. Spotify said no music will be permanently held back.Among the first local releases is Badshah and Divya Kumar's new single ‘Chimna’, which will be available to Premium subscribers on August 28. The song will be available to all listeners on August 31.Harrdy Sandhu's new single ‘Stuck On You’ is also part of the first wave of releases. It will be available to Premium subscribers from August 28 and to all listeners from August 31.Spotify said more local and international artists will be added to the programme in the coming weeks.Premium Early Access will be available to users on Spotify Premium Standard, Premium Platinum and Premium Student plans in India.Eligible releases will appear automatically in users' feeds, with no action required from subscribers.Spotify Free users will be able to listen to every Premium Early Access release once the early access window ends. The company said users who want earlier access can subscribe to a Premium plan.The feature will only apply to releases where artists and their labels have collaborated with Spotify to participate in the programme. Spotify said not all new releases will have an early access window.
Article Summary: Premium early access will be available to users on spotify premium standard, premium platinum and premium student plans in india. Universal music group (umg) will be the first label to launch its ‘hear it first’ campaign under the new framework.

Article Title: OpenAI brings ads to ChatGPT in India; here’s who will see them
Article Text:
Self‑serve access to ChatGPT Ads Manager in India

OpenAI’s approach to advertising

Helping Indian businesses be discovered

ChatGPT-maker OpenAI has announced that the launch ChatGPT Ads in India. The company has revealed that it is expanding its advertising program to one of ChatGPT’s largest and most active markets. The company confirmed that the ads will roll out to logged‑in adults using the Free and Go tiers, while Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education subscriptions will remain ad‑free. WPP and Omnicom will be OpenAI’s first agency partners for ChatGPT Ads in India. With more than 50 brands set to go live this week, these agencies bring strong relationships across industries and expertise in strategy, creative, measurement, brand safety, and campaign execution. OpenAI said the model is non‑exclusive and it will continue to identify and work with other agencies.On September 4, OpenAI will launch self‑serve access to ChatGPT Ads Manager in India, enabling businesses of all sizes to sign up with daily budgets starting as low as ₹725. Dave Dugan, Vice President and Head of Global Ads Solutions, said: “India is one of the most dynamic markets in the world for how people use ChatGPT to learn, build, and discover.With ChatGPT Ads, businesses of every size can introduce themselves at relevant, high‑context moments when decisions are beginning to take shape. ”OpenAI outlined five guiding principles for ChatGPT Ads:* Answer independence: Ads do not influence ChatGPT’s answers.* Conversation privacy: Advertisers do not access chats, history, or personal details.* Choice and control: Users can dismiss ads, manage personalization, and clear data.* Mission alignment: Ads support broader access to AI through free and lower‑cost options.* Long‑term value: User trust and quality are prioritized over short‑term revenue.Ads will appear below ChatGPT responses when relevant, clearly labeled as sponsored, and visually separate from answers. They will not be shown to users under 18 or alongside sensitive topics such as mental health and politics.ChatGPT Ads aim to help businesses connect with people at moments of active consideration, creating opportunities for established companies, small businesses, and emerging Indian brands. OpenAI said it will continue learning from feedback to improve relevance and introduce new formats and buying options, while maintaining a clear separation between advertising and ChatGPT’s answers.
Article Summary: Wpp and omnicom will be openai’s first agency partners for chatgpt ads in india. The ads will roll out to logged‑in adults using the free and go tiers, while plus, pro, business, enterprise, and education subscriptions will remain ad‑free.

Article Title: Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion in AI deal
Article Text:
Nvidia employees have reportedly seen their wealth rise sharply

Why Hugging Face matters to Nvidia's strategy

A price tag far outpacing revenue

Nvidia's broader bet on AI demand

The deal follows a recent security scare

Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy the open‑source AI model repository Hugging Face for $12.9 billion according to The Information. This deal would mark one of Nvidia’s biggest acquisitions to date and also underscores CEO Jensen Huang’s bet that demand for AI technology is still expanding rather than peaking. For those unaware, Hugging Face hosts open‑source large language models and datasets, giving Nvidia a powerful position at a time when rivals like Anthropic and OpenAI are exploring their own chip alternatives to Nvidia’s GPUs. The reported price tag stands in sharp contrast to Hugging Face’s annualised revenue of $150 million.Acquiring Hugging Face would give Nvidia control over one of the most important hosting platforms for open-source large language models and datasets, at a moment when builders of closed-source models — including Anthropic and OpenAI — are working to develop their own custom chips as alternatives to Nvidia's graphics processing units. Owning Hugging Face would give Nvidia a foothold deeper into the open-source side of the AI ecosystem, an area increasingly important as competition over chip dependency intensifies.The reported $12.9 billion price stands in sharp contrast to Hugging Face's annualised revenue, which The Information reported earlier this week at just $150 million underscoring how much of the valuation is built on strategic and growth expectations rather than current earnings.Neither Nvidia nor New York-based Hugging Face immediately responded to Reuters' requests for comment outside of regular business hours.The Hugging Face report emerged the same day Nvidia forecast a 70% jump in revenue for its next fiscal year, reinforcing the company's confidence that AI demand remains on a steep upward trajectory. Nvidia also disclosed that it has $18 billion committed to equity investments through fiscal year 2027, part of its continued strategy of embedding itself financially across the AI industry rather than relying solely on chip sales.The acquisition report also comes about a month after Hugging Face was hit by a security incident in which an OpenAI model reportedly went rogue and triggered a hack that compromised Hugging Face's infrastructure — an episode that raised fresh questions about security risks tied to hosting and running third-party AI models at scale.
Article Summary: N nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy the open-source ai model repository hugging face for $12.9 billion according to the information. This deal would mark one of nvidia’s biggest acquisitions to date and underscores ceo jensen huang's bet that demand for ai technology is still expanding rather than peaking.
